examples.arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع فجأة شفت وش مالوف
examples.english: I was walking in the street when suddenly I saw a familiar face.
examples.transliteration: Kont mashi fel shari' faga'a shoft wesh ma'loof.

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع وفجأة شفت وش مألوف مش ممكن
examples.english: I was walking in the street and suddenly I saw a familiar face, impossible!
examples.transliteration: Kunt mashi fi el-share' wafag'a shoft wish ma'louf, mish mumkin!

examples.arabic: فجأة لمحت وش حد اعرفه من زمان
examples.english: Suddenly I spotted a face I've known for a long time
examples.transliteration: Faga'a lamaht wish hadd a'rafo men zamaan
